achievements.name: Big Adventurer
achievements.description: Even Scarlet didn't get all the achievements, you're truly a Knitted Knight of legend.

achievements.name: You've got potential, squire!
achievements.description: Defeat the Master of the Uproar boss on The Soaring Summit (the first world's boss).

achievements.name: Metameric Malady
achievements.description: Complete 'Centipedal Force', the final level of the Colossal Canopy, defeating its boss.

achievements.name: Sonar So Good
achievements.description: Complete 'The Deep End', the final level of the Kingdom of Crablantis, defeating the Bringer of Nightmares.

achievements.name: Crash Override
achievements.description: Complete 'Nervous System', the final level of the Interstellar Junction, cleaning up N.A.O.M.I's code.

achievements.name: Vex Vanquisher!
achievements.description: Defeat Vex in 'Until Vex Time', near the end of the Centre of Craftworld.

achievements.name: Verified Vex Vanquisher!
achievements.description: Beat Vex for the fourth and final time, destroy the Topsy Turver and complete the story.

achievements.name: Daydream Believer
achievements.description: Push back the Uproar for the first time (a story beat).

achievements.name: Book of Dreams
achievements.description: Collect all the stickers in a single World.

achievements.name: Squired Up
achievements.description: Discover the Trials of the Knitted Knights.

achievements.name: Out of bounds
achievements.description: Pick up and throw 30 of Vex's minions to their doom.

achievements.name: Pop 'n' Lobber
achievements.description: Defeat 30 of Vex's minions from a distance.

achievements.name: Multitasking
achievements.description: Defeat multiple minions simultaneously 10 times.

achievements.name: Bounder
achievements.description: Defeat 30 of Vex's minions by bouncing on them.

achievements.name: Stunner
achievements.description: Stun 30 of Vex's minions.

achievements.name: Fashionista!
achievements.description: Complete your first Costume.

achievements.name: Re-Mix-Master
achievements.description: Earn a Gold rank in any Remix level.

achievements.name: Knights of Gold
achievements.description: Earn a Gold rank in any Knitted Knight Trial.

achievements.name: Cut it out!
achievements.description: Complete Highs and Glows... without throwing the Whirltool.

achievements.name: Slide Away
achievements.description: Over the course of your adventure, collect 3000 points while sliding.

achievements.name: Bubble Binger
achievements.description: Collect a full chain of Timed Score Bubbles 30 times.

achievements.name: Gymnastic Fantastic
achievements.description: While in the air, perform four actions before touching the ground.

achievements.name: BEE! ARGH! BEE!
achievements.description: Pick up, and hold on to, a Boomblebee Hive for 60 seconds.

achievements.name: Buddy Beater
achievements.description: In multiplayer, get the top score on the scoreboard 20 times.

achievements.name: Thespian
achievements.description: Create your own custom Emote in Zom Zom's shop then show the world.

achievements.name: Icon of Style
achievements.description: Save a custom-made costume to your Wardrobe.

achievements.name: Let's twist again...
achievements.description: In multiplayer, start a dance party with your friends.

achievements.name: Up high!
achievements.description: In multiplayer, high five with a friend.

achievements.name: Sore Winner
achievements.description: In multiplayer, clobber one of your chums as the champ.

achievements.name: Stop! Thief!
achievements.description: In multiplayer, snatch an item from the clutches of another player.

achievements.name: Slap Attack
achievements.description: In multiplayer, have two players slap each other at exactly the same time.

achievements.name: Beast of burden
achievements.description: In multiplayer, get gold in any Knitted Knight Trial while carrying another Sackperson.

achievements.name: Fun Multiplied
achievements.description: In multiplayer, complete a Teamwork Level.

achievements.name: Capitalist
achievements.description: In multiplayer, snag the most Collectabells in a level 20 times.

achievements.name: Saviour
achievements.description: In multiplayer, save your fallen friends from certain doom!

achievements.name: Naturalist
achievements.description: Find all of Gerald's secret spots.

achievements.name: Player's Player
achievements.description: Find and pick up every fish, paintbrush and cocktail umbrella on your journey.

achievements.name: Amazing Ace
achievements.description: Ace 30 levels by completing them without dying.

achievements.name: Best Friends
achievements.description: In multiplayer mode, earn 10 Ace level goals.

achievements.name: Walk-in Wardrobe
achievements.description: Fill your wardrobe with 300 costume pieces.

achievements.name: Master of One
achievements.description: Get a golden level badge by completing all the Level Goals for a single level.

achievements.name: Multi-Master
achievements.description: Achieve all the level goals for 10 different levels.

achievements.name: Best Friends Forever
achievements.description: In multiplayer, defeat the Topsy Turver (the final boss) as a team.

achievements.name: Wonderplane Workout
achievements.description: Mop up the last remnants of the Uproar (a late-game story beat).

achievements.name: Golden Boy
achievements.description: Earn Gold on the scoreboard in 50 different levels!

achievements.name: String it Together
achievements.description: Get a Gold on the Knitted Knight’s ultimate trial.
